title: Uniform Non-Localization under Robin Boundary Perturbations: Spectral Splitting and Bounded Eigenspace Complexity
summary: We study the high-energy spectral effect of Robin boundary perturbations on complete Laplace eigenspaces and its consequences for eigenfunction non-localization. Highly degenerate Neumann levels generally split under Robin perturbation, but this splitting need not produce a simple spectrum: distinct modal classes may still contribute to the same Robin eigenvalue.
